title: Uncertainty Quantification for Evaluating Gender Bias in Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the predictive uncertainty of machine translation models (using metrics like Semantic Entropy and Similarity-sensitive Shannon Entropy) when translating sentences with gender-ambiguous and unambiguous nouns into languages with grammatical gender.

Performing an analysis of variance (ANOVA) to measure how grammatical and cognitive cues (such as subject position, recency, and implicit causality) affect the variance of normalized entropy and influence gender markers in translations.
